pairs.why: B keeps the real card's build: a plain folding chair with a rectangular back panel and X legs. A is a puffy, glossy armchair with lime piping that the real card doesn't have.
Both have the right build, but B's fabric wraps around the seat and back tubes with capped ends, and its green is softer, so it reads more like the real stool-chair.
A hangs flat on the striped wall with a soft wall shadow, like the real card, while B stands on a floor ledge, which changes how the whole card reads.
Both are nearly identical glossy orange wall clocks on lime stripes, and neither gets closer to the real card's deeper, calmer orange rim.
A is mounted on the wall with a cast shadow, as in the real card, while B sits on a floor shelf like a desk clock.
B's thicker, darker rim is closer to the real colour, but A's wall mounting and soft wall shadow match the real card's overall setup better.
